reports.title: Rich is +$0.23 on the NFL early games, a 4-leg overs parlay is still breathing, and the scoreboard froze at 2:55 CT.
reports.text:
The scoreboard's been frozen since 2:55 CT. Open the Bet Tracker app to thaw it out.

**MY BETS:** 1-2, net +$0.23 on $124.74. Twenty-three cents! Put it on the mantel. PIT/NO Under 42.5 cashed easy (16-10, +$40). TB/CAR Under 45.5 got rumblin', bumblin', stumblin' into a 43-13 bonfire (-$19.80). The 3-leg parlay is dead too: CAR -2.5 lost by 32.5 (-$19.97). Live: NYG +10.5 is winning outright, 21-14 with 5:06 left. Big Blue Wrecking Crew! The 4-leg overs ($24.99 to win $347.11) is alive but on a ventilator: CLE/TEN is over (+4.5), SF/ATL needs 3 more in 2:42, NYG/HOU needs 8 more in 5:06 (on pace for 38 vs 42.5), and then KC/SEA still has to go over 42.5.

**AI-LOX:** 1-1, -$5.91 at suggested stakes. Rich rode both and is +$20.20 on them. The computer's own Under 44.5 in Tampa got torched for 56 points. Whoop!

**THE MODEL:** 3 of 12 final. Winners 2/3, vs spread 1-2, totals 2-1, average miss 12.6 points. Closest call: MIN 16-10 over IND (model 24-20). Worst miss: TB 43-13 (the model had it 21-19 Carolina, so pull the plug). Live: the model had HOU 27-20 and it's 21-14 Giants. SF and the Jets are losing too, while CIN and CLE are winning.

Running total: +$0.23, with KC@SEA, the late games and SNF still to come. That's why they play the games.
